title: Independent reproducibility audit of M1 (3rd machine/operator)
context: Independent re-execution in M1 (reexec-012) used a second operator/machine. For M2 robustness, a third independent operator on yet another machine performs a full reproducibility audit of the M1 headline results. This third-party check validates that the reproducibility claim holds beyond a single pairwise comparison and surfaces any environment-specific non-reproducibility. Non-reproducible results are flagged, not silently dropped.
objective: Have a third independent operator (different from both the original pilot-009 runner and the reexec-012 verifier) re-execute the M1 pilot reanalysis from the run manifest on a third machine and produce a formal audit report.
acceptanceCriteria: A third operator (different from the original runner and from the reexec-012 operator) re-executes the pilot reanalysis from the run manifest on a third distinct machine/environment.
Headline results reproduce within the declared numeric tolerance from repro-standard-003; any divergence is flagged with a root-cause note.
A formal audit report is committed documenting: operator identity (may be pseudonymous), machine/environment, pipeline version, run manifest reference, and per-headline-result reproduction outcome.
The audit report is licensed CC-BY-4.0 and committed to the project repo.
resources: proteomics-reanalysis-reexec-012 (M1 re-execution artifact and run manifest reference)
output: A committed formal reproducibility audit report from a third independent operator/machine confirming or flagging M1 headline result reproducibility; licensed CC-BY-4.0.
